3_where_the_planned_stop_lives.why_not: those are shared with the legacy route and gained nothing - asserted

refused_in_two_places: from_candidate - six conditions, each with its own code
assert_sendable - missing plan, wrong instrument, fewer contracts than the order
4_can_an_entry_be_sendable_without_a_pla.notable: a long whose stop sits above its entry is not a stop, it is a target, and it would trigger the moment it reached a broker - caught here rather than there

5_lifecycle_verbs.switch_same_symbol: BUILT, intent-only, TWO legs journalled separately, close first
5_lifecycle_verbs.open_position: was already built in 5W and does hand its order to its broker

5_lifecycle_verbs.every_refusal_precedes_the_journal_row: a refused operation leaves no trace a later reader could mistake for an attempt

6_cross_day_book.before: write_route_checkpoint synthesised positions: [] on every production call - harmless while the route holds nothing, and exactly wrong the moment it does

now.no book: a flat one is created, book_carried_from: None
now.book exists: positions carried forward and restamped, book_carried_from names the file
now.unreadable: the write is REFUSED and the file is left exactly as it was

6_cross_day_book.why_the_refusal_matters: 'I could not read what I hold' answered as 'I hold nothing' is the shape that erases a real position, and a window close that did it would be unrecoverable
6_cross_day_book.book_advances_only_on_a_confirmed_fill: asserted - intending a close does not move it
6_cross_day_book.restart_classification: MATCH / MISMATCH / UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN blocks entries, allows exits, and never becomes MATCH

7_unverified_until_paper.one_thing: that a broker actually holds the stop that was planned
covers: whether an abandoned one is left behind
7_unverified_until_paper.why: every part of it needs an order to exist first, and none does

reported_as.broker_stop_reason: no Track 1 order has ever been sent, so no stop has ever been placed for one to be compared against; this needs paper

proof: run_live_day, run_stop_repair and run_maxhold_exit mention no planned_stop literal and read no such attribute (asserted)
sleeve_identity hashes identical before and after exercising the new path
the planned-stop module imports no signal, rule, sleeve or calm module (AST)
the module does NO arithmetic beyond the two subtractions that make stop_distance (AST over its BinOps)

11_only_evidence_operator_paper_left.caveat: the lifecycle verbs produce INTENT and the send step is deliberately not built. Wiring a real call site is a stage of its own and should come AFTER the gates open, not before - the day it is built is the day the distance between the scheduler and a broker stops being structural. Until then the remaining code is a wire, not a design.

live_confirmation_of_the_previous_stage.event: the 02:55 ET NKD close, between 5ZM and this stage
live_confirmation_of_the_previous_stage.checkpoint_detail: route ok, 5 entr(y/ies) through ['2026-08-24'] (2 days behind), book cut 2026-08-26, 0 open position(s) matched
live_confirmation_of_the_previous_stage.significance: the second Track 1 window ever to pass, and the first with a checkpoint anything could resume from

what_was_missing.measured: Candidate carries stop_price and it survives admission; candidate_to_order builds an Order with nowhere to put it, and OrderRecord had nowhere either
what_was_missing.consequence: the planned stop reached the edge of the order path and was dropped; the protective stop was placed later by the safety sweep in another process, and NOTHING anywhere held both the intended price and the placed one
what_was_missing.precedent: an abandoned stop left by a close on 2026-08-10 filled and opened a position the opposite way - which is why a stop with no record is an accounting hole

defect_found_by_building_on_it.reality: a path the book has never occupied; every other component uses the repository root, and that is where track1_bootstrap.write puts it
defect_found_by_building_on_it.consequence: read_book treats a missing file as an empty book, so that constant made reconcile_at_startup compare an ALWAYS-empty book against the broker and conclude the route was flat whatever it held - 'resume flat against a book that is not', in the one object built to prevent it
defect_found_by_building_on_it.fix: corrected and READ FROM track1_slots rather than restated, so the two cannot drift

a_test_was_green_because_of_it.problem: it asserted the book was ABSENT and passed by asserting something true of a file nobody writes
a_test_was_green_because_of_it.rewritten_to: the constant matches the route's own, and the book exists and is flat - a different fact from not existing

tests.fake_broker_raises_on_send: so a send would fail loudly rather than pass quietly
notable: AST: the planned-stop module does no arithmetic beyond the distance
AST: each new verb never touches self.broker
behavioural: a refused operation leaves the journal empty

a_pin_i_nearly_weakened_and_did_not.pin: six tests across five suites assert that NOTHING WHICH RUNS imports the order path - part of the argument that there is no route from the scheduler to a broker
a_pin_i_nearly_weakened_and_did_not.what_broke_it: my first reporting block imported the executor to read hasattr for a panel field
a_pin_i_nearly_weakened_and_did_not.done_instead: the report DECLARES the verb names and a test compares that declaration against the real class, where imports are free. Production's import graph is unchanged, the claim stays checked, and a panel field did not buy the first import into the order path.

one_rule_widened_with_its_reason.test: 5V - every serialised journal value is str | int | float
one_rule_widened_with_its_reason.why_widened: the planned-stop fields default to None, and None is LOAD-BEARING: 'no plan travelled with this row' must be distinguishable from a stop at a price, and 0.0 would collide with a real one. None round-trips through JSON unchanged, so the property the line guards still holds.

remaining_before_paper.item: B1 - separate account, or a proven-flat legacy book
broker stop proof, partial fills, an order in flight across a restart

honest_summary: nothing Track 1 needs is unknown any more. What is left is a machine that must stay awake, an account decision, five clean days, and a broker.
claims_deliberately_NOT_made: that any stop has been placed
